title: UAPx becomes Project X at University at Albany

tellings.quote:
original UAPX, and now UAPX has been

Albany,

plain: Kevin Knuth, a physicist and former NASA scientist, says that UAPx, a private group he helped run that studied unexplained flying objects, has been dissolved. He says its work has moved to the University at Albany in New York, where it is now called Project X. If true, the study of these objects has found a home in a regular university.
